APP_TITLE: Isikhungo Semfundo Sabaqalisi Be Afrika - Ngaphandle
WELCOME_SUB: Isango Lokuthuthukisa iAfrika Nge Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Ekugubheni uSuku lweAfrika lwama-25, lolu hlelo lokuqeqesha abaqalisi be Pi luyethulwa)
INTRO_P1: I Pi Network yiphrojekthi yehlabathi yemali yedijithali kanye ne ecosystem eklanyelwe ukwenza i cryptocurrency ifinyeleleke futhi ibe wusizo kubantu abajwayelekile.
INTRO_P2: Ngokungafani lama cryptocurrencies endabuko avamise ukudinga imishini yokumba ebizayo kanye lokusebenzisa ugesi omningi, i Pi Network ivumela abantu abajwayelekile ukuthi babambe iqhaza ngqo kumakhalekhukhwini wabo.
INTRO_P3: Umbono we Pi Network wukwakha i ecosystem eqhutshwa ngabantu lapho imali yedijithali ingasetshenziselwa khona umsebenzi wangempela, izinsizakalo zangempela, imiphakathi yangempela kanye lokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho okuyikho.
GLOBAL_MISSION: Umsebenzi Omkhulu Wehlabathi we Pi Network
M1: Yakha umnotho wedijithali obandakanya wonke umuntu
M2: Nika abantu abajwayelekile amandla emhlabeni wonke
M4: Sekela ukuthunyelana kwemali ngqo phakathi kwabantu
M5: Yakha i ecosystem elawulwa ngendlela ye decentralized
CH1_SUB: Wamukelekile ku Africa Pioneers Education Hub - External. Le platform yadalelwa ukufundisa, ukunika amandla kanye lokulungiselela amavulandlela e Afrika kanye lamabhizinesi ukuze babambe iqhaza okungokoqobo ku Pi Ecosystem.
REG2: Bhalisa usebenzisa i Facebook noma Inombolo Yocingo
DAILY_MINING: Ukumba Kwansuku Zonke: Buya njalo ngemva kwamahora angu 24 ukuze uqhubeke nokumba.
WALLET_SEC: Ukuvikeleka Kwe Wallet: Ungaze wabelane ngamazwi akho angu 24 e Passphrase. Lowo olawula i passphrase ulawula i wallet.
CH2_DESC: Funda indlela yokwamukela lokuthumela i Pi ngokuphepha usebenzisa i Pi Wallet ku Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: ISAHLUKO 2A — UKUQEQESHWA OKUNGOKOQOBO NGE PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Qala ngamanani amancane okuhlola, qinisekisa amakheli, ungalokothi wabelane nge passphrase.
CH3_DESC: I Pi Browser DApps yizinhlelo zokusebenza ze decentralized zokusetshenziswa okungokoqobo.
CH4_DESC: Thola amabhizinesi asebenzisana le Pi emhlabeni wonke.
CH5_DESC: I Global Consensus Value ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwangempela kwe ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Funda i Doris Yin Handbook yokudalwa kokusetshenziswa kanye lokukhula kwe ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Indlela yokujoyina i ecosystem, ukufaka ibhizinesi ku MapOfPi, ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze Pi.
FINAL_P: I Afrika inethuba lokuba ngesinye sezifunda ezinamandla kakhulu zokusebenzisa okungokoqobo ngaphakathi kwe Pi Ecosystem. Sakha Sisonke. Sifundisa Sisonke. Sinika i Afrika Amandla Sisonke Nge Pi.
